Feature schema v1 classifies lax.scatter but not scatter-min; the scatter primitive is not counted.

full.description: Every body and variant at all four trips and factors.
full.selection: all bodies, all variants, trips 64/100/256/1023, all factors, three process repeats

smoke.description: One primary variant per smoke body, divisible and remainder trips.
smoke.selection: tier=smoke, primary variant, trips 64 and 100, all factors, one process repeat

unsupported.reason: fori_loop bounds must be static integers
lax.while_loop has a data-dependent trip count
a scan inside a scan is nested control flow
lax.cond inside a scan is nested control flow

dynamic output shapes are not jittable in this corpus
effectful debug printing is outside the timing domain

workloads.description: Branchless bisection bracket update for a cubic root.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip evaluates the cubic residual at the bracket midpoint and uses a sign comparison plus select to move the low or high endpoint.

provenance.adaptation: Branchless bracket-update rule reimplemented from the documentation; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Data-dependent control through select rather than dense arithmetic: the scalar or 4-lane carry holds a bracket, the body performs no indexed memory access, and the dependency chain is one comparison and two selects per element.

workloads.description: Decaying matrix carry updated by rank-one outer products.
workloads.mechanism: rank-one matrix update with multiplicative contraction

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: The carry is a small matrix and each step updates it with an outer product, so there is no matrix-vector contraction and no indexed memory.

workloads.description: Elementwise polynomial recurrence with quadratic and bilinear forcing.
workloads.mechanism: polynomial elementwise map with a decaying carry

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Pure elementwise arithmetic with no neighbor, segment, or gate logic; it isolates polynomial arithmetic from memory-access effects.

workloads.description: Elementwise recurrence mixing sine, cosine, and tanh.
workloads.mechanism: bounded transcendental map with a linear carry decay

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Adds three transcendental operations per element with no memory structure, separating transcendental cost from structured dependencies.

workloads.description: Counter-assisted bucket traversal.
workloads.mechanism: Rows are read from a bucket table; the next bucket depends on the previous row statistic and the loop counter, while a vector accumulator integrates tanh(row).

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Loop state (the counter) and a row statistic both steer a two-dimensional bucket traversal with vector carry; there is no scalar pointer chain.

workloads.description: Linked-list pointer chase over a static next-pointer table.
workloads.mechanism: An integer next-pointer table walks a fixed cycle while payload loads feed a decaying scalar accumulator.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Address transitions come from an indirection table rather than payload arithmetic or buckets, giving pointer-chasing traversal.

workloads.description: Eight parallel dependent pointer chains.
workloads.mechanism: Eight lane pointers each advance using their own loaded value while an eight-lane accumulator integrates the payload.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Vector pointer state and vector carry run eight independent payload-derived chains per trip instead of one scalar chain.

workloads.description: Scalar pointer chase with payload-derived addresses.
workloads.mechanism: The next index is the previous index advanced by one plus a bucket of the previous loaded value; a scalar accumulator decays and adds the payload.

provenance.adaptation: Dependent gather traversal reimplemented from the message-passing description; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Address transition depends on the loaded float payload, forming a single dependent chain with no index stream.

workloads.description: Two-level dependent indirection.
workloads.mechanism: A first load yields the address for a second load; the chain index combines both levels and a scalar accumulator integrates the payload.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Load-to-address dependency inside one trip gives two dependent loads, not just a payload-derived index update.

workloads.description: Duplicate-row gather with replicated row addresses and a paired weighted reduction.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip gathers 8 rows whose 4 base row indices each appear twice, adds the replicated row pairs, then reduces with per-row gains into a scalar carry.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Within-trip 2-way row-address duplication stresses replicated 2D loads and combines duplicate payloads before reduction, unlike a one-dimensional element gather.

variants.d1024: 1024x4 table, 8 row loads with 2-way row duplicates
variants.d128: 128x4 table, 8 row loads with 2-way row duplicates

workloads.description: Masked vector gather with out-of-bounds fill lanes.
workloads.mechanism: Eight random table loads per trip are attempted; masked lanes redirect to an out-of-bounds sentinel and return fill value zero before the weighted sum enters a scalar carry.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: The mask changes the address set itself: disabled lanes issue out-of-bounds fill gathers instead of in-bounds loads whose payload is later zeroed.

workloads.description: Two-table gather selected per trip by a predicate.
workloads.mechanism: Loads rows at independent indices from two tables and selects one with a Boolean stream before a vector update.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Two distinct table bases and two indexed reads per trip gated by a data-dependent selector; the loaded rows are not combined arithmetically.

workloads.description: Row gather with in-row pooling feeding an 8-lane recurrence.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip loads a 16-wide row at a random row index, folds it to 8 lanes by pairwise addition, and applies a tanh-scaled vector update.

provenance.adaptation: Documented gather semantics reimplemented from scratch; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Two-dimensional table with a row gather plus partial reduction; vector carry of 8 lanes instead of a scalar, and random row addresses.

workloads.description: Scalar table lookup with data-dependent 1-D indices feeding a scalar recurrence.
workloads.mechanism: One random scalar load from a 1-D table per trip; carry = 0.9*carry + value*gain.

provenance.adaptation: Documented gather semantics reimplemented from scratch; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Single scalar payload and scalar carry; the address stream is an unconstrained random 1-D index with no vector lanes or reduction.

workloads.description: Sorted contiguous block gather with pairwise pooling.
workloads.mechanism: Monotone sorted block starts select 8 consecutive elements per trip, pool adjacent pairs, and drive a 4-lane recurrence.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Addresses advance in sorted order with static intra-block offsets and pairwise pooling; sequential spatial locality with no collisions, unlike the random scalar and row gathers.

workloads.description: Colliding additive scatter into a 2D grid.
workloads.mechanism: Twelve random (row, column) index pairs per trip may repeat; updates are added into the addressed cells after a 0.99 decay of the whole grid.

provenance.adaptation: Documented scatter semantics reimplemented from scratch; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Two-dimensional scatter-add with row/column collisions, rather than a one-dimensional duplicate-index accumulator.

workloads.description: Colliding min-reduction scatter.
workloads.mechanism: Twelve random indices per trip apply elementwise minimum updates to the addressed slots.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Monotone min reduction with duplicate indices resolves repeated addresses by reduction rather than addition or overwrite; the fori_loop body indexes its streams with the counter.

workloads.description: Dense block-local permutation scatter.
workloads.mechanism: Every trip moves every element to a fixed permuted position after a tanh update driven by a scalar stream.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Full-width permutation scatter writes each slot exactly once at static unique addresses, in contrast to sparse data-dependent uniqueness.

workloads.description: Predicate-directed read-modify-write across two tables.
workloads.mechanism: Eight unique indices per trip read both tables; a Boolean lane sends the blended tanh update to the left table when true and to the right table when false, while both tables are read and written each trip.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Two simultaneous table gathers and two unique scatters per trip with predicate-directed destinations, instead of one table and one masked payload write.

workloads.description: Read-modify-write of unique table rows.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip reads 4 distinct rows, applies tanh(current+update) to an 8-wide row vector, and writes the rows back with a unique-index set.

provenance.adaptation: Documented scatter semantics reimplemented from scratch; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Row-granularity unique-index scatter with 2D read-modify-write payloads, contrasting with element-granularity sparse updates.

variants.r128: 128 rows of width 8, 4 unique row writes
variants.r512: 512 rows of width 8, 4 unique row writes

workloads.description: Hot-row reuse via repeated reads and writes.
workloads.mechanism: A tiny working set of rows is revisited by counter-indexed reads and in-place tanh updates.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: High temporal reuse of a few contiguous rows with read-modify-write; addresses stay in a small hot set instead of sweeping the table.

workloads.description: Full-table permutation read.
workloads.mechanism: Every trip reads the entire table through a fixed permutation and reduces it with static weights.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: All elements are consumed each trip for maximum reuse across trips, but in scrambled order rather than in windows or blocks.

workloads.description: Random contiguous window read.
workloads.mechanism: An eight-wide contiguous window is loaded from a random base per trip and drives a vector recurrence.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Contiguous windows improve within-window locality, but random bases remove the sequential streaming reuse of the streaming body and differ from strided sampling.

workloads.description: Sequential streaming read of adjacent window pairs.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip reads two adjacent eight-wide windows, compares their sums with tanh, and advances the start by one window width.

provenance.adaptation: Grid-access pattern reimplemented from the project description; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Two adjacent contiguous windows per trip create a sequential contrast reduction, unlike a single random-window sum.

workloads.description: Fixed-stride sampled read.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip samples 8 elements spaced five apart from a random base and updates a vector carry.

provenance.adaptation: Independent body written for this corpus; no external code reused.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: A constant nonzero stride inside each sample lowers cache-line use even though the sample pattern is fixed; distinct from contiguous windows.

workloads.description: Fixed-kernel 1D FIR filter over a shift-register history.
workloads.mechanism: weighted tap sum over a shifted sample history

provenance.adaptation: Windowed-reduction semantics reimplemented as a scan from scratch; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Uses a fixed nonuniform kernel and only a history carry; unlike the sliding mean it has no running sum that can be updated incrementally.

workloads.description: Windowed dot product of two synchronized input streams.
workloads.mechanism: two shift registers with a per-step inner product

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Two independent windows advance together and are multiplied pairwise; there is no fixed kernel and no scalar accumulator across steps.

workloads.description: Rolling maximum over a shift-register window.
workloads.mechanism: Each trip shifts the window, performs a full max reduction inside the loop body, and carries the resulting window maximum.

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: The window reduction is a max computed every trip, so old samples cannot be removed with an incremental subtraction; the loop carries both the window and its current extremum.

variants.w16: 16-sample window with a scalar input stream
variants.w32: 32-sample window with a scalar input stream

workloads.description: Sliding mean over a shift register with an incremental sum.
workloads.mechanism: shift-register window plus subtract-old/add-new running sum

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Carries the whole window and a scalar sum, so the window shift and the moment update are separate dependencies; no per-step window reduction.

variants.w16: 16-sample window with a scalar input stream
variants.w8: 8-sample window with a scalar input stream

workloads.description: Sliding variance from incrementally updated first and second moments.
workloads.mechanism: window carry plus running sum and sum-of-squares

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Tracks two moment accumulators alongside the window and cancels the departed sample in both; the final variance adds a subtractive coupling.

variants.w12: 12-sample window with scalar sum and sum-of-squares state
variants.w24: 24-sample window with scalar sum and sum-of-squares state

workloads.description: Segment-gated exponential average that carries state across boundaries.
workloads.mechanism: boundary-dependent blend without discarding prior state

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Unlike the reset bodies it never zeroes the accumulator: a new segment uses a different blend coefficient, so state propagates across segments.

workloads.description: Segmented maximum that resets at each segment boundary.
workloads.mechanism: segment-id-gated max reset

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Shares the segment-boundary select with the segmented sum but reduces with a compare-select, so the accumulator is non-invertible.

workloads.description: Segmented sum that resets at each segment boundary.
workloads.mechanism: segment-id-gated additive reset

provenance.adaptation: Segmented-scan semantics reimplemented sequentially from the documentation; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: A carried segment id selects between starting a new accumulator and continuing it; the dependency chain restarts at every boundary.

workloads.description: Segmented weighted mean with numerator and denominator resets.
workloads.mechanism: two segment-local accumulators followed by a ratio

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Tracks a weight total alongside the weighted sum and normalizes once; the state has twice the width and a division at the output.

variants.w4_short: 4-channel values and weights with 2-5 step segments
variants.w8_long: 8-channel values and weights with 8-20 step segments

workloads.description: Damped coupled-oscillator ring driven through a fori_loop.
workloads.mechanism: position-velocity state with neighbor coupling and weak damping

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Two wide carries form a second-order system with spatial coupling and a loop-counter-driven fori_loop; it is the longest dependency chain here.

workloads.description: GRU-like gated recurrence with reset and update gates.
workloads.mechanism: sigmoid gates over dense input and hidden projections

provenance.adaptation: LSTM/GRU cell equations reimplemented without Flax modules; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Adds two multiplicative gates and a tanh candidate around the carry; the nonlinear gating makes the chain longer than either IIR body.

workloads.description: LSTM-like cell with input, forget, output, and candidate gates.
workloads.mechanism: two-state gated cell recurrence

provenance.adaptation: LSTM/GRU cell equations reimplemented without Flax modules; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Carries both cell and hidden state with three sigmoid gates; the cell path is an additional long dependency that the GRU body does not have.

workloads.description: First-order scalar low-pass IIR recurrence normalized to unit DC gain.
workloads.mechanism: scalar one-pole linear recurrence

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: A single scalar carry with a short unit-step chain; the companion vector body widens the carry and adds neighbor coupling.

variants.scalar: scalar carry and scalar input stream

workloads.description: Wide vector IIR with nearest-neighbor state coupling.
workloads.mechanism: shift-coupled vector one-pole recurrence

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: The carry is a vector and each component also reads a rolled neighbor, producing a wide carry with cross-channel dependencies rather than independent channels.

workloads.description: Anisotropic 2D stencil with a distance-two horizontal term.
workloads.mechanism: unequal axis weights plus a radius-two x-direction Laplacian

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Combines asymmetric axis coefficients with a second-neighbor tap, so its dependency radius is two on one axis and one on the other.

workloads.description: Periodic 1D three-point diffusion via static-bound fori_loop.
workloads.mechanism: nearest-neighbor 1D Laplacian update

provenance.adaptation: Finite-difference stencil reimplemented from the project description; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: One-axis dependency with radius one and a loop-counter-driven fori_loop; the other stencils are 2D grids with larger neighborhoods.

workloads.description: Periodic 2D five-point diffusion stencil.
workloads.mechanism: axis-neighbor 2D Laplacian with radius-one support

provenance.adaptation: Finite-difference stencil reimplemented from the project description; no code copied.
provenance.license: Apache-2.0

workloads.structural_difference: Touches four axis neighbors in two dimensions; unlike the 1D body it has a two-axis dependency pattern and a larger per-step tensor.

workloads.description: Periodic 2D nine-point stencil with diagonal coupling.
workloads.mechanism: axis plus diagonal neighbor average with a center weight

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Adds four diagonal neighbors and a weighted center, giving a denser dependency fan-in than the five-point body at the same grid size.

workloads.description: Decaying running maximum and minimum without explicit resets.
workloads.mechanism: forgetful max/min compare-and-select state

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: Uses multiplicative decay plus a compare-select instead of additive updates; the two extrema are independent scalar or small-vector carries.

variants.scalar: scalar stream with scalar maximum and minimum

workloads.description: Online log-sum-exp normalizer with a running maximum.
workloads.mechanism: max-shifted exponential accumulation

provenance.adaptation: Online-softmax reduction reimplemented from the paper algorithm; no code copied.
provenance.license: Paper algorithm; FlashAttention repository is BSD-3-Clause

workloads.structural_difference: Carries a maximum and a shifted exponential sum that are updated with two transcendentals; unlike mean and variance it is a normalizer, not a moment.

variants.scalar: scalar stream with scalar normalizer state

workloads.description: Whole-stream online mean with a growing sample count.
workloads.mechanism: incremental mean update with a scalar count carry

provenance.adaptation: No adaptation; written independently for the structured corpus.
provenance.license: No repository license file; original code

workloads.structural_difference: No fixed window; the divisor grows with the trip count, so the update uses division by a carried count instead of a constant window length.

variants.scalar: scalar stream and scalar mean state

workloads.description: Online Welford variance with mean, second moment, and count.
workloads.mechanism: stable single-pass variance update

provenance.adaptation: Welford update reimplemented from the documented algorithm; no code copied.
provenance.license: BSD-2-Clause

workloads.structural_difference: Carries three coupled scalars or vectors and updates the second moment from the change in mean; deeper state and a different reduction identity.

variants.scalar: scalar stream and scalar moment state
